source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 38, smallholder and rainfall-shock vulnerability discussion

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR reports poorer villages face more excessive or deficient rainfall; poorer smallholders are highly exposed to food insecurity and unstable livelihoods and lack resources to adapt.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 39, Figure 23 drought and flood vulnerability overlay

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: Highest drought-vulnerability pockets are Southern District, Kgalagadi and western Ghanzi; Ngamiland Delta subdistrict and Francistown combine high flood risk with many poor households.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 38, Ngamiland East smallholder adaptation discussion

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: In Ngamiland East, smallholders use hybrid seeds, changed planting and water harvesting; access to credit remains a barrier to investment.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 17 and 38-39, social exclusion and climate vulnerability discussion

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: Kalahari communal pastoralists are disproportionately affected by land privatization; Ngamiland, Chobe and Central combine high climate impacts with social exclusion, whose reported drivers include process-legitimacy and social-cohesion challenges.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 39, gendered climate exposure and adaptation discussion

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR says women's water-collection and natural-resource roles heighten climate exposure; Bogakhwe knowledge, drought-tolerant crops and livelihood diversification support adaptation, while female-headed households in Kweneng show resilience and women report less institutional confidence.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 56-57, 2015 drought-risk assessment and administrative areas

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: The plan's 2015 assessment found over 50% precipitation shortfalls in parts of Ngamiland, Ghanzi and Kgalagadi; other high-risk areas had 25-50% deficits.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 59-62, drought monitoring and early-warning diagnosis

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: In 2020 the plan described drought monitoring and impact assessment as reactive; it noted sparse hydrometeorological stations and missing data, and proposed community-engaged early warning.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 60, drought declaration and relief options

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: The plan describes presidential drought declarations after interministerial assessment and lists possible public works, under-five clinic feeding and farm-subsidy responses.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 65, drought mitigation and integrated water management

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: Proposed drought measures include integrated water management to mitigate upstream-downstream water-user conflicts and coordinate users, communities and sectors.
